_readme: PARTNER TRACKING - the advertisers and their tracking links.
Each partner listed here with "active": true gets a page at /go/<id>/,
which records the click and sends the visitor on to their website.
THE LIST BELOW IS EMPTY ON PURPOSE. No partner has been agreed, and a
fabricated example on a live site is a lie about who sponsors you. Add a
real one only when a real agreement exists.
WHAT EVERY ENTRY NEEDS
id          the slug, so the link is /go/<id>/. Lower case, hyphens.
name        the company's name as it should appear to a reader.
url         where the visitor is sent. https only.
refCode     the code the advertiser will look for, to credit RCF
English with the enrolment. Agree it with them in writing.
disclosure  the sentence shown to the reader before they are sent on.
This is not optional - see below.
active      false parks an entry without deleting it. No page is built.
OPTIONAL
utm         extra query parameters appended to the destination.
note        for your own reference. Never shown to a reader.
DISCLOSURE IS A LEGAL AND POLICY MATTER, NOT A COURTESY
A link you are paid for must be disclosed to the reader, and must carry
rel="sponsored" wherever it is shown on the site. Google's link spam
policy treats undisclosed paid links as manipulation, and the penalty
lands on the whole domain - including the AdSense income the partnership
was meant to add to. The build enforces the disclosure field; it cannot
enforce your honesty about what the arrangement is.
NEVER PUT A PASSWORD, AN API KEY OR A CONTRACT VALUE IN THIS FILE.
It is published with the site and anybody can read it.
